1.
We have heard the learned Advocates for the respective sides and the learned Senior Advocate along with Shri. Lokhande, the learned Advocate for the Corporation.

There is a consensus between the parties that the land of the Petitioner,
which is being utilized for the purposes of burial/cremation of the dead bodies of persons professing the Christian and Muslim 6936.24wp religion and those belonging to the Matang, falling in the Scheduled Caste category.
2. According to the Petitioner, her land is occupied for crematorium, for burial and also for a mosque.

sentences.text: It is mentioned on behalf of the Corporation that, thereafter steps would be taken for initiating acquisition proceeding only to the extent of the area of land, which is required for the said purposes.
The Corporation is under an obligation to initiate the acquisition proceeding.

3. In view of the above, the Writ Petition, as well as the Civil Application, are disposed off, with the following directions in the light of the statements of the parties :-
A) Let the measurement of the land in Survey No.130/1 i.e. Gut No.28/1 be carried out by following the due procedure laid down in law, within a period of 90 days.

6936.24wp B) The Petitioner and the Corporation shall equally share the cost of the measurement and shall deposit the said amounts in equal shares, with the Taluka Inspector of Land Records (TILR) at Nagapur, Tq. and Dist. Ahmednagar.
(C) The Petitioner shall place a copy of this order before the TILR and request for a Challan.
Let such Challan be issued by the TILR within 10 days from the date of submitting the representation along with a copy of this order.
D) Within 60 days of the generation of the Challan, the measurement would be carried out.

Within 30 days thereafter, the sketch map and the measurement report would be delivered to the Corporation and also a copy to the Petitioner.
E) The Corporation would decide the area of the land, which is required for the above stated purposes, and shall initiate steps for acquisition within 60 days from the date of receiving the sketch map and the measurement report.

6936.24wp F) The acquisition proceeding shall be concluded within timeline, as is prescribed under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
